title: "Altair concatenation"

  html_document:
    self_contained: false

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reticulate)
```

```{python first}
import altair as alt

chart = alt.Chart(alt.Data(values=[{"x": 1, "y": 2}])).mark_point().encode(
    x="x:Q", y="y:Q"
)
concatenated = alt.concat(chart, chart)
concatenated
concatenated
```

```{python second}
concatenated
```
